description.en: Whether node deletion also removes incident relationships; select explicitly after reviewing the preview.

description.zh: rename_type 要匹配的现有类型名。
description.en: Existing type name matched by rename_type.

description.zh: rename_type 保存的新类型名。
description.en: New type name saved by rename_type.

result.zh: 返回提交结果与新 revision。版本冲突需重新读取并预览；之后调用 load_constructed_graph 更新活动会话。
result.en: Returns commit status and a new revision. On a revision conflict, read and preview again; then use load_constructed_graph to update the active session.

notes.zh: 必须保持与预览相同的 base_revision 和 operations，并完成用户确认。remove_from_node 与 cascade 应明确填写预期行为。
notes.en: Keep base_revision and operations identical to the preview and obtain user confirmation. Set remove_from_node and cascade explicitly to express the intended behavior.

text.zh: 这 3 项由 MCP Server 单独注册，不在 61 项工具目录中。原生 GraphMCPTools 没有过滤它们，工具发现可以取得其数据模式。它们操作 MCP 连接的显式会话绑定；原生 Run 通常通过身份请求头定位业务会话，由宿主服务管理生命周期。
text.en: These 3 interfaces are registered separately by the MCP server and are not part of the 61-tool catalog. Native GraphMCPTools does not filter them, so discovery can obtain their schemas. They operate on explicit MCP connection bindings; native runs normally identify business sessions through headers, with lifecycle managed by the host service.

rows.zh: register_session
rows.en: register_session

rows.zh: agent_session_id: string，必需；user_id: string|null，可选，默认空字符串。ctx 由 MCP 注入。
rows.en: agent_session_id: string, required; user_id: string|null, optional, default empty string. ctx is injected by MCP.

rows.zh: 将当前 MCP 连接绑定到业务会话并请求 Graph Engine 创建会话，返回注册/创建结果。ID 应取自真实宿主会话；原生按请求头定位会话时通常不需要模型另建绑定。
rows.en: Bind the MCP connection to a business session and request session creation in Graph Engine, returning registration/creation status. Use IDs from the actual host session; native header-scoped runs normally do not need a model-created binding.

rows.zh: delete_graph_session
rows.en: delete_graph_session

rows.zh: 无公开参数；ctx 由 MCP 注入。
rows.en: No public parameters; ctx is injected by MCP.

rows.zh: 解除当前 MCP 连接的注册绑定并删除其 Graph Engine 会话。没有显式绑定时返回 success=true，不代表请求头指定的会话已删除。此接口用于会话释放。
rows.en: Remove the current MCP connection binding and delete its Graph Engine session. With no explicit binding, returns success=true without implying that a header-identified session was deleted. Used for session teardown.

rows.zh: set_session_config
rows.en: set_session_config

rows.zh: llm_model: string|null，必须传该字段但值可为 null；ctx 由 MCP 注入。
rows.en: llm_model: string|null; the field must be supplied, but null is allowed. ctx is injected by MCP.

rows.zh: 为显式绑定的 MCP 会话设置抽图等功能使用的 LLM 模型；非空值触发更新，null 不更新。未注册连接返回 session_not_registered，不能假定请求头身份等于注册绑定。
rows.en: Set the LLM model used by extraction and related operations for an explicitly bound MCP session. A non-empty value triggers an update; null does not. Unregistered connections return session_not_registered; header identity is not the same as a registered binding.

title.zh: 示例：路径分析与图视图
title.en: Example: path analysis and a graph view

text.zh: 在可访问 Graph Engine HTTP 服务的服务端环境运行下面的 Python 示例。先通过工作台创建一个用于演示的会话并使其图会话注册完成，再设置 GRAPH_ENGINE_URL、IGRAPH_SESSION_ID、IGRAPH_USER_ID 和 IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY。演示中的 load_graph 会替换该会话的活动图；后续子图调用使用 create_version=false。
text.en: Run this Python example in a server environment with access to Graph Engine HTTP. First create a demo session in the workspace and ensure its graph session is registered, then set GRAPH_ENGINE_URL, IGRAPH_SESSION_ID, IGRAPH_USER_ID and IGRAPH_CONTROL_SERVICE_KEY. The example load_graph replaces that session’s active graph; the later subgraph call uses create_version=false.

text.zh: 示例权重表示距离或成本。图有 4 个节点、5 条有向边；A→B→C→D 的总成本为 4，优于 A→C→D 和 A→B→D 的成本 6。
text.en: Weights in this example represent distance or cost. The graph has 4 nodes and 5 directed edges. A→B→C→D costs 4, while A→C→D and A→B→D each cost 6.

rows.zh: shortest_path · use_weight=true
rows.en: shortest_path · use_weight=true

rows.zh: path=[A,B,C,D]，hop_count=3，total_length=4。
rows.en: path=[A,B,C,D], hop_count=3, total_length=4.

rows.zh: shortest_path · use_weight=false
rows.en: shortest_path · use_weight=false

rows.zh: 最少 2 跳；并列路径可能返回 A→B→D 或 A→C→D。
rows.en: Minimum of 2 hops; a tied result may be A→B→D or A→C→D.

rows.zh: subgraph_extraction · create_version=false
rows.en: subgraph_extraction · create_version=false

rows.zh: 只预览 A、B、C 的诱导子图，活动图仍包含 D。
rows.en: Previews the graph induced by A, B and C; D remains in the active graph.

rows.zh: visualize_subgraph · highlights.paths
rows.en: visualize_subgraph · highlights.paths

rows.zh: 在完整活动图视图中突出 A→B→C→D，不从截断视图重新计算最短路径。
rows.en: Highlights A→B→C→D in the active-graph view, without recomputing the path from a truncated view.

text.zh: 若要比较多条候选路线，把 shortest_path 的 algorithm 设为 yen_k_shortest、k 设为 3；若只关心等代价最优解，使用 all_shortest_paths。需要保存子图时再明确启用 create_version，并记录返回的 graph_version。
text.en: To compare alternative routes, set shortest_path algorithm to yen_k_shortest and k to 3. To inspect only equal-cost optimal routes, use all_shortest_paths. Enable create_version explicitly when saving a subgraph and retain the returned graph_version.
